BFF Bikes Endurance Ride

Chicago, IL · Bucktown · Road

BFF Bikes Endurance Ride is a road group ride in Chicago, IL. It rolls some Sundays at 8:00 am from BFF Bikes. About 30-50 miles, 15-18 mph.

The Oct 25 listing reads Beginner Gravel Ride or Endurance Ride, 8:00 am to 1:30 pm, so the shop may run a gravel outing that day. Check the event page before you go.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 8:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 15-18 mph: brisk — you'll want some fitness.
Check
Look at @bffbikes the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the BFF Bikes Endurance Ride group ride

The shop's longer Sunday ride: 30 to 50 miles at 15 to 18 mph from the shop door on Damen. Posted date by date on the shop's events calendar, roughly monthly.
